package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/tc-hib/winres"
	"github.com/tc-hib/winres/version"
)

func main() {
	f, _ := os.Open(os.Args[1])
	rs, err := winres.LoadFromEXE(f)
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	rs.WalkType(winres.RT_VERSION, func(r winres.Identifier, l uint16, d []byte) bool {
		fmt.Printf("lang=%#x\n", l)
		vi, err := version.FromBytes(d)
		if err != nil { fmt.Println(err); return true }
		j, _ := vi.MarshalJSON()
		fmt.Println(string(j))
		return true
	})
}
